column3: Close to the Greek; “lap” is rendered “bosom.”
Close to the Greek; “splinter” and “beam” are rendered “speck” and “plank.”
NKJV includes “of his heart” after the evil treasure and has “the heart,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “out of the evil (treasure)” and “out of the abundance of the heart.”
NKJV has “it was founded on the rock,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “because it had been well built.”
